max_tire.note: Many LC250/GX 550 owners run it without mods, and 265/70R18 fits with no problems. 285/70R18 is where rubbing starts.
35s generally need a leveling kit or a small lift.

items.title: V35A engine main-bearing debris
items.summary: Machining debris can cause main-bearing failure, a stall and loss of power. Dealers inspect the #1 main bearing and replace the engine if needed (Lexus 25LA07).

items.title: Panoramic View Monitor camera freeze
items.summary: A software error can freeze the rear camera image or leave the screen blank in reverse. Dealers update the parking-assist software.

items.title: Instrument cluster warnings may not display
items.summary: The combination meter may fail to show some warnings or indicators. Fixed with an over-the-air software update.

items.title: Load-capacity modification label
items.summary: The label may show the wrong added-weight values. Dealers replace the label.

tsbs.title: Front brake squeal, forward or reverse
tsbs.summary: Some 2024 GX 550s squeal from the front brakes. A LandCruiserForum member says the dealer fix closely mirrors a Tundra fix; LC250 dealers have replaced pads, rotors and shims under warranty.

timeline.change: Revealed June 8, 2023 on the GA-F platform with a 349 hp 3.4 twin-turbo V6 and a 10-speed. Six grades, including the new Overtrail and Overtrail+ with a rear e-locker and 33-in A/Ts. Production started in November 2023.
3,717 early US trucks (built May 2023 – April 2024) are in engine recall 25V-767. Check the VIN.
Driver memory settings and a power steering column on every grade. The Overtrail and Overtrail+ gain a 1-in suspension lift. NHTSA lists the 25V-767 engine recall for 2024 GXs only.
Minor updates: ventilated rear outboard seats on Luxury, Luxury+ and Overtrail+, plus extended keyless entry. Powertrain unchanged.

identify.intro: The GX 550 shares its bones with the Land Cruiser 250, so the questions are which grade it is and whether it was built before the engine-recall fix.

items.head: VIN
items.body: US trucks start JTJ. NHTSA's vPIC decoder reads them as the 252 Series with the V35A-FTS engine, built at Tahara, Japan. The 10th character is the model year (R = 2024, S = 2025, T = 2026).

items.head: Overtrail vs road grades
items.body: Overtrail and Overtrail+ have the electronically locking rear differential, E-KDSS, 33-in A/T tires on 18s and a body 4.52 in wider than the GX 460. Seven seats are listed only on the non-Overtrail grades.

items.head: 2025+ Overtrail lift
items.body: From 2025 the Overtrail sits 1 in higher from the factory, which matters if you're comparing a used 2024 against a later truck.

items.head: Engine recall status
items.body: 2024 trucks built between May 31, 2023 and April 10, 2024 fall under 25V-767 (Lexus 25LA07). Ask for dealer paperwork showing the inspection or engine replacement.

capability.note: 2027 Lexus figures. Launch spec was 8,000 lb for Premium, Premium+ and Overtrail

values.intro: Still a current model, so new prices set the market. So far the only GX 550s to sell at auction have been Overtrails.
values.note: MSRPs include the $1,550 destination charge. On Bring a Trailer, two 2024 GX 550 Overtrails sold for $70,524 and $72,000 in mid-2025.
